rationale: The biosimilar infliximab equivalence evidence directly extends the infliximab recommendation for perianal fistulas by establishing that biosimilar infliximab (Inflectra/Remsima) can substitute for originator Remicade without loss of efficacy in this indication, supporting cost-effective treatment.

The biosimilar infliximab equivalence evidence extends the infliximab recommendation for enterocutaneous and rectovaginal fistulas by establishing biosimilar substitution as a cost-effective alternative to originator Remicade for this indication.

The biosimilar infliximab equivalence evidence extends the antibiotics-plus-infliximab combination recommendation by confirming that biosimilar infliximab can replace originator Remicade in the combination regimen without compromising efficacy.
